label: 随机POI分布
description: 在网格指定区域值上随机散布兴趣点（POI），支持单网格、多值网格、网格列表三种输入格式，输出格式与输入保持一致。
description-en: Randomly scatters Points of Interest onto cells matching specified target values; supports single grid, multi-value grid, and grid-list inputs, preserving the input format in output.
icon: 深色网格上散落若干彩色小圆点标记，每种颜色对应一类POI，圆点周围留有最小间距，扁平插画风格，简洁小图标，主色2种。

inputs.name: inputGrid
inputs.label: 输入网格
inputs.description: 单张输入网格 (number[][])，网格列表由 DataTree 引擎自动逐张处理
inputs.description-en: Single input grid (number[][]); grid lists are handled per-item by the DataTree engine.

inputs.name: poiRules
inputs.label: POI规则列表
inputs.description: POI规则，单条与批量同一端口。单条可直接写 {"洞穴": "7:4:12"} 或裸文本 洞穴:7:4:12；批量写列表 [{"洞穴":"7:4:12"},{"营火":"4:8:6"}]、多键对象 {"洞穴":"7:4:12","营火":"4:8:6"} 或分号分隔 洞穴:7:4:12；营火:4:8:6。值为 targetValue:count:minDistance。也兼容旧格式 [{decoration, targetValue, count, minDistance}]
inputs.description-en: POI rules; single or batch on the same port. Single: {"cave": "7:4:12"} or bare text cave:7:4:12. Batch: a list, a multi-key object, or semicolon-separated entries. Value is targetValue:count:minDistance. Legacy {decoration, targetValue, count, minDistance} still accepted.

inputs.name: assetNames
inputs.label: 资产名
inputs.description: POI 资产名，与 poiRules 按下标一一对应。单条直接写 樱花树；批量写 [樱花树,松树]、樱花树,松树 或 樱花树；松树。留空则用规则名作为资产名
inputs.description-en: POI asset names, index-aligned with poiRules. Single: a plain name; batch: [a,b], "a,b" or "a;b". Empty falls back to each rule's own name.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.label: 随机种子
inputs.description: 随机种子，0表示使用当前时间自动随机

outputs.name: outputGrid
outputs.label: 输出网格
outputs.description: 单张多值网格：每种POI一个递增id，未放置处为0；可接 grid_split_by_value 拆分
outputs.description-en: Single multi-value grid: each POI type gets an increasing id, 0 elsewhere; pipe to grid_split_by_value to separate.

outputs.name: outputNameList
outputs.label: 名称清单
outputs.description: 网格中实际出现的POI条目，格式为 [{id, name, type}]，type 固定为 asset
outputs.description-en: Name list for POI ids actually present in the grid: [{id, name, type}], type is always "asset".

outputs.name: outputAssetNames
outputs.label: 逐点资产名
outputs.description: 按行优先逐个已放置 POI 的资产名列表，顺序与 alg_field2points 采样出的点列表严格一致，可直接喂给下游 scene_set_attribute 逐点写 asset_name
outputs.description-en: Per-placed-POI asset names in row-major order, exactly matching the point list produced by alg_field2points; feed straight into a downstream scene_set_attribute.

outputs.name: placedCount
outputs.label: 成功放置数量
outputs.description: 所有规则中成功放置的POI点总数
outputs.description-en: Total number of POI points successfully placed across all rules.
